Student Records query (DB-backed)

Student Records — Query

Search GLR learners and view classlist modules; shows a warning if no classlist modules are found for a student.

DB-backed
How to use
  • Search GLR learners by Student ID (contains a digit) or by name tokens (all tokens must match FirstName LastName).
  • Select a student row to view modules from classlists. If none exist, a warning is shown.
  • Year rule: numeric classlist year if available; otherwise numeric GLR year; otherwise blank. Applies to summaries and module rows.
  • Module semesters are bucketed as S1/FY/S2/Other using part-of-term codes.
Search
If the query contains a digit, search is by Student ID. Otherwise all tokens must appear in FirstName LastName.
